source_crs: EPSG:3857 / Web Mercator metres (ArcGIS WKID 102100, latestWKID 3857)
method: Inverse spherical Web Mercator each vertex to WGS84; approximate local project transform x=(lon+86.9137)*84810.60416539927 m, y=(lat-40.4274)*111040 m; calculate local planar bounding box, polygon area and closed-ring perimeter by shoelace and Euclidean segment formulas. No vertical conversion performed.
interpretation: Raw Shape__Area/Length are computed in distorted Web Mercator map-plane coordinates; do not use Shape__Area as ground area. The locally transformed values remain approximate because the source ring is generalized and the local projection formula is not survey-grade.
